scientific_integrity: Original claims restricted to explicitly defined continuous and chord-inclusive stationary signed twice-area rates; established unreset gyrator and generic moment-resetting principles credited.
scientific_limitations: Overdamped linear harmonic two-coordinate diffusion only
Strictly positive two bath temperatures, coupling and reset intensity
Reset of only the first coordinate exactly to zero
No assertion about winding angle, entropy production, probability-current field, nonlinear or inertial models
title: Two competing rotation reversals under one-coordinate resetting of a harmonic Brownian gyrator
